current_unit: Task 6: Overlays and window chrome (modify tests/electron-chrome-windows.test.ts)
notes: Task 5 complete: added 'app tray' and 'director window' describe blocks to tests/electron-chrome-windows.test.ts. Reproduced the multi-resetModules-in-one-file failure predicted by Task 4's notes (all three new tests failed with the plan's example per-test vi.resetModules()+reimport pattern), then converted the whole file to the top-level-import + beforeEach(electronMock.reset()) pattern already proven in tests/window-managers.test.ts -- safe here since settings-window/tray/director-window each hold only a module-level singleton and each describe block calls its open function once per test. Corrected plan example configs against real signatures: TrayDeps has no store field (full literal: port/serverError/operatorPin/adminPin/onOpen* callbacks); registerDirectorIpc takes {officeManager: OfficeManager, getOffices} not a state store, so built a minimal duck-typed OfficeManager fake (getSnapshot/fireAction stubs). Added nativeImage.createFromDataURL to tests/setup/electron-mock.ts (tray.ts calls it then .setTemplateImage(true); mock only had createFromPath). Verified npx tsc --noEmit clean and npx vitest run clean (1197/1197) except tests/companion-defs.test.ts, the same pre-existing unrelated packages/companion-module-pconair deps gap documented since Task 1. Container had no node_modules at session start -- ran npm ci first. Housekeeping: git pull left HEAD detached in this container while local main stayed stale; re-pointed main at the new commit after confirming a clean fast-forward (git merge-base --is-ancestor) before pushing -- worth checking for on every firing in this environment, not just this one. Task 6 (Overlays and window chrome) is still Phase 0, not a phase/effort boundary, no native bindings/signing -- fine to dispatch in the same batch.
